# TÜKENMEZ KALEM (Turkish Ballpoint Pen) - WHAT'S INSIDE STORYBOARD

---

## SCENE 1: DISASSEMBLY & COMPONENT REVEAL
**Duration:** 45 seconds

**Visual Description:**
- Close-up camera shot of intact ballpoint pen rotating slowly on turntable
- Smooth hand reaches in and begins disassembling the pen
- Each component is carefully separated and laid out left-to-right on a contrasting surface
- Components appear in this order: gövde (barrel), yay (spring), mürekkep haznesi (ink reservoir), bilye uç (ball tip)
- Each part moves into a labeled position with clear lighting highlighting details

**Onscreen Text (Turkish/English):**
- [0-5s] "TÜKENMEZDEKİ SIRLAR / SECRETS INSIDE"
- [10-15s] "1. GÖVDE / BARREL" (label appears as barrel is isolated)
- [18-25s] "2. YAY / SPRING" (label appears as spring is isolated, close-up of coil texture)
- [28-35s] "3. MÜREKKEP HAZNESİ / INK RESERVOIR" (label appears, camera zooms on transparent tube showing ink)
- [38-43s] "4. BİLYE UÇ / BALL TIP" (label appears, macro shot shows tiny metal sphere)

---

## SCENE 2: HOW IT WORKS - MECHANISM DEMONSTRATION
**Duration:** 55 seconds

**Visual Description:**
- Animated or slow-motion assembly sequence showing how components fit together
- Spring compressed and released to show tension mechanism
- Ink flowing from reservoir toward the ball tip in slow-motion (use clear fluid simulation or actual demonstration)
- Cross-section diagram (animated or physical cutaway view) showing ink channel pathway
- Final assembly of complete pen, then writing demonstration showing ink flow to paper
- Close-up of ball tip rotating on paper, distributing ink evenly

**Onscreen Text (Turkish/English):**
- [0-8s] "NASIL ÇALIŞIR? / HOW DOES IT WORK?"
- [10-18s] "YAY, MÜREKKEP AKIŞINI KONTROL EDER / SPRING CONTROLS INK FLOW"
- [20-32s] "BİLYE, MÜREKKEBI KAĞIDA AKTARIR / BALL TIP TRANSFERS INK TO PAPER"
- [35-48s] "YAZIŞTA, BİLYE DÖNEREREKMÜREKKEP DAĞILIR / AS YOU WRITE, BALL ROTATES & DISTRIBUTES INK"
- [50-55s] "BASIT AMA MÜKEMMEL TASARIM / SIMPLE BUT PERFECT DESIGN"

---

**Production Notes:**
- Use macro/close-up cinematography for detailed component visibility
- Implement smooth transitions between scenes with subtle ink-drop or pen-stroke transitions
- Suggested background: minimalist white or light gray for product clarity
- Add subtle background music with pen-clicking/writing sound effects
